text: Nine p.m. A storm knocks out the power.
When the lights come back on... the diamond is gone.
Four suspects. One of them is lying.
The butler: I was lighting candles in the hall.
The maid: I was in the kitchen, making tea.
The gardener: I was outside, closing the greenhouse. I heard the thunder... then I saw the lightning.
The niece: I was upstairs, reading with my phone's flashlight.
Comment the number. The answer is in the next video.
